lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like distribution of circular high-luminance spots posterior to the gill slits, primarily arranged in longitudinal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse light intensity intersecting with horizontal carinae; spots are positioned at the nodes of this grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible on the upper flank, displaying high pixel intensity on the superior surface and sharp shadow gradients on the inferior surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs on the proximal half of the first dorsal fin lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, low-luminance biological entities partially occluding the ventral-lateral region and pectoral fin silhouette.
